name: 冰蓝渐变面部精华液款
description: 冰蓝渐变精华瓶套图模版，海洋气泡视觉，八镜全漏斗转化

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF and pearl white #F7FAFE for packshots and spec screens, dreamy ice blue #DDE9F8 to ocean blue #2E6BD6 gradients for benefit, mechanism and CTA shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft cool studio lighting, upper-left key with gentle fill, luminous halo accents, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte white-wood vanity counter #EDE7DE and pale ice-blue matte panel #E9F1FA
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, deep navy #24437C headlines with ocean blue #2E6BD6 accents
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line circular badge icons and fine-line ring graphics, single ocean blue accent
styleLock.presentationRules: the frosted gradient bottle stays upright and prominent, stable hero scale, label fully legible, bubbles and glow never cover the label
noDrift: no bubbles or glow covering the product label
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool ocean-blue skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pearl white #F7FAFE, ice blue #DDE9F8, ocean blue accent #2E6BD6 and deep navy text #24437C; bright soft cool studio lighting with gentle gradient glow and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; minimal thin-line circular badge icon style; dreamy bubble-and-glow ocean aesthetic mixed with clean infographic elements; stable product scale with the bottle kept upright and the label fully legible; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表首图合规干净，赢取第一时间点击。

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: none, the product fills the frame with even margins
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bottle standing upright and centered, straight-on eye-level view, full product visible. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace. 8K, commercial skincare e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no color cast on the background, no cut-off edges, no floating without contact shadow.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 冰蓝渐变磨砂瓶精华配金属瓶盖，海洋气泡梦幻首图，标题区主打提亮卖点并带圆形数据徽章；P2 饮食习惯三灰卡痛点版与勾选式卖点列表；P3 瓶身放射光效与环形卖点徽章；P4 试管气泡成分图与三球成分圆及三步骤编号版式；P5 三步骤卡片与白色规格信息卡（品牌/系列/产地/肤质/功效/规格行）旁站立的瓶身；P6 问答版式，画面贴有会员角标与二维码。品类判定：品名为主打提亮补水的面部精华，规格卡注明适用肤质与面部护理功效，判定为护肤个护/面部护理而非洗护发，与源夹名不符已改判。已剥离：原品牌名与系列名、原文案原句、全部成分配比与百分比数值、功效数值断言、产地与规格数值、会员角标与二维码；数值一律以 {callout_n}/{selling_point_n} 占位，功效不作事实断言，空白证明位以空徽章/空卡行呈现。
